notes.subject: ⟨ke⟩
notes.rationale: Sepedi copula supplied for Hebrew verbless clause ga go karabo ya Elohim.

notes.subject: ועטו על שפם
notes.rationale: Covering the upper lip is a mourning/shame gesture; rendered literally 'ba tla khupetša mošufi wa bona'.

notes.subject: ובשו / וחפרו
notes.rationale: Paired shame verbs (pale/be ashamed, blush/be disappointed) — near-synonym doubling lost as two Sepedi shame verbs.

translation: Gomme ba boni ba tla swarwa ke mašwabi, gomme ba laoloki ba tla tshwarwa ke mahlatse, gomme ba tla khupetša godimo ga mošufi wa bona ka moka, ka gobane ga go ⟨ke⟩ karabo ya Elohim.

tokens.gloss: gomme ba tla swarwa ke mašwabi
gomme ba tla tshwarwa ke mahlatse
